item.title: Wed 07 Oct 2026: Records on Wall Street, Fed minutes tonight, FRAME deadline moves to 22 Oct, EU pauses Level 2 rules
item.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq close at records while Treasury and gilt yields stay near multi-decade highs and oil trades on Hormuz headlines. The Fed publishes its September minutes tonight; the FCA's FRAME consultation now closes on 22 October, and the European Commission is pausing non-essential Level 2 rules until October 2027. Plus Capel's launch, Apollo's daily pricing, three COO action points and the week's diary.

item.title: Mon 05 Oct 2026: Weak US payrolls cool Fed hike bets, euro area inflation 3.8%, BoE November hike signals, reform deadlines

item.title: Fri 02 Oct 2026: FTSE worst day since May, 30-year gilt tops 6%, payrolls day, private credit freeze
item.description: The FTSE 100 suffers its worst day since May as the 30-year gilt yield breaks six per cent for the first time since 1998, while Wall Street edges higher as Treasury yields ease. Today brings US payrolls and euro area flash inflation, ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: ESMA's MiCA review response, FCA board changes and a calendar of fund deadlines; funds: the Metrics private credit freeze, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.

item.title: Thu 01 Oct 2026: UK growth revised up, Treasury yields at 24-year high, FCA sustainability rules, Australian private credit freeze
item.description: Wall Street ends September with the 10-year Treasury yield above 5.3 per cent despite cooler US inflation, while UK second-quarter growth is revised up to 0.5 per cent and gilts rally ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: the FCA finalises UK sustainability reporting rules for listed issuers (PS26/19) and crypto perimeter guidance (PS26/18), and Ombudsman reforms start today. Funds: Metrics freezes Australian private credit funds after an auditor dispute, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.

item.title: Wed 30 Sep 2026: Long yields at 24-year highs, BoE pauses gilt sales, FCA crypto gateway opens, fund M&A wave
item.description: Wall Street slips for a second day as the 30-year Treasury yield hits its highest since 2002 and US consumer confidence falls to a 12-year low; the Bank of England is reported to pause gilt sales ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: the FCA cryptoasset application window opens, the UK AIFM regime consultation runs to 22 October, and Ombudsman changes start on 1 October. Funds: T. Rowe Price, Victory Capital and Vanguard deals point to a consolidation wave, plus three COO action points.

item.title: Tue 29 Sep 2026: Yields hit cycle highs, Hormuz oil shock, FCA CFD crackdown, Apollo gates again
item.description: US 10-year above 5.25% and gilts near two-decade highs; Brent at $107 after the US rejects Iran's Hormuz plan; BoE's 6-3 hold and November hike pricing; Lagarde on measured hikes before Friday's flash HICP. Regulation: FCA CFD crackdown, FOS changes from 1 October, Form PF delayed to July 2027, SEC pay-to-play rescission, frontier AI and operational resilience. Funds: Apollo Debt Solutions caps redemptions, AllianceBernstein names Onur Erzan CEO, active ETF hires and launches. Plus three COO action points.
